content: Great men exist that there may be greater men.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: The giants of history were not sent to enslave us with awe, but to show us what human nature is capable of, challenging us to climb even higher.
practicalInsight: Let your heroes inspire you to reach your own peak rather than resting in passive admiration.
reflectionPrompt: Who is your greatest hero, and how are you embodying their courage in your own arena?
